name: BACH_0109
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], 0% invasive risk, and unflagged tier-4 priority with a drafted ER stain order.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 100%, Invasive 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong in situ separation |
| Conformal set | InSitu (10% alpha, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged input, high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; 1 Invasive (84% similarity) | Mostly InSitu, one Invasive neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 2, 3) · context · Above-typical score (1.91, contribution -1.39); 8/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Anti-invasive score (-1.05); 12/20 AI spot-check acceptable [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 6) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable pro-invasive score (+0.77); failed 0/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Pro-invasive score (+0.56); 18/20 AI spot-check acceptable · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 1, 5, 11) · context · 71% neoplastic nuclei (97th percentile) [F7], 2380/mm² density (93rd) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in region 8 (12% risk) or matches invasive neighbor BACH_0265 (differs in necrosis, duct confinement).
- High out-of-distribution score (94th percentile) or small validation cohort (n=132, 24 patients, 5% ECE) miscalibrates probabilities.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 11, 10**: Inspect highest-risk heatmap regions (12%, 4%, 2% risk) to exclude stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 9**: Verify intact duct boundaries around atypical cells, contrasting with invasive case BACH_0265.
3. **Regions 1, 5, 11**: Check dense pleomorphic nuclei (90th-percentile shape variation [F9]) and drafted ER order.
